inputs.label: Galileo color
inputs.acquisition: Checked-in derived RGBA GeoTIFF. Reproduce with python3 src/planets/callisto/source/preparation/prepare-galileo-color.py from the pinned original and fixed camera; no controlled-map texture is sampled.
inputs.coverage: 28.735% spherical coverage: fixed perspective projection, emission <=65 degrees and fully opaque original contributors. Gray grid elsewhere; no globally filled color. GDAL_NODATA=0 is reserved for all-zero RGBA, with explicit all-channels RGB validity.
inputs.photometry: Published processed display colors, not calibrated I/F or albedo. Source photographed shading and color fringing remain. No new radiometric correction.
